name: Credit Line 3
definition: Set of elements used to provide details of the credit line.

Included.name: Included
Included.definition: Indicates whether or not the credit line is included in the balance.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of the credit line provided when multiple credit lines may be provided.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money of the credit line.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date of the credit line provided when multiple credit lines may be provided.
